invariants.rationale: The method always returns a (possibly empty) Option, so the result should not be null.
indexInstantTime is passed through to another class and used to create the result, so a null value may cause NPE downstream.
context is used to construct RunIndexActionExecutor and must be non-null for operation.
Ensures that result is an Option, and its isPresent state is well-defined (trivially true but expresses Option usage at this point).
Ensures the result is an instance of Option, as per the method signature and implementation.
